contactIdentity.rule: Exact normalized phone OR exact normalized email establishes Contact identity. Name is supporting evidence only. Customer ownership remains separately mandatory. Ambiguous/multiple exact Contact matches fail closed.

apiEfficiency.rule: No periodic background Operational Striven report refresh. Operational data refreshes only on demand at the Sales Order freshness boundary. Customer bulk TTL is not increased until request-scoped pre-write duplicate proof is verified.

customerFreshnessAlignment.rule: Write-layer Customer freshness is 120 minutes to match the already-enforced data-layer minimum. This adds no new staleness; it removes repeated no-op refresh attempts between 15 and 120 minutes. Do not extend bulk TTL further until request-scoped duplicate proof is verified.
